notes: Single physical connector: a 3-pin XLR that carries both the balanced mic-level/line-level audio output and +48V phantom power (required to run the internal preamp; a bypass switch reverts to passive SM7B-style operation without phantom power). No USB or headphone jack is built into the microphone itself — USB connectivity is only available via the separate Shure MVX2U XLR-to-USB adapter accessory, which is not part of the SM7dB unit and thus not included here. No grade applies to XLR (not a bandwidth-graded connector type in the given scale). Output impedance: 150 ohm (bypass mode) / 27 ohm (preamp mode, +18/+28dB switchable). Desktop/mic-stand mounted device, not rack-mountable.

ports.name: Output
ports.note: 3-pin XLR balanced audio output; also receives +48V phantom power from the connected interface/mixer to power the internal preamp (bypass switch allows passive operation without phantom power)
